episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: Hey there everybody, I have glass here.
So our show today is something that producer Khanna Joffee Walt has been collaborating on with reporter Nicole Hannah Jones.
And Nicole's version of this story, which is in the New York Times magazine, is something that many, many people are discussing online right now.

And I just want to say that if you have seen that article, there are a lot of things in what you're about to hear that are not in the article, particularly you'll get to hear at length from Nicole's daughter.
And there are things that commenters are raising online that get interestingly addressed in our version.
